# RBX Labs

RBX Labs is a founder-led applied AI studio with a Research & Practice Lab. It builds AI products and workflows, delivers practical training, and runs applied research on AI judgment and runtime trust.

- Home: https://rbx-labs.io/

- Public research archive: https://rbx-labs.io/research/

- Google Cloud Generative AI Leader study guide: https://rbx-labs.io/GAIL/

## What RBX Labs does
- Builds AI-powered products and internal tools
- Designs AI workflows that reduce manual work and improve throughput
- Creates AI-enabled go-to-market systems when they are part of a defined execution problem
- Runs AI training through workshops, sprints, and adoption programs
- Researches AI judgment, delegated thinking, and capability-relevant delegation
- Researches runtime trust, evaluation, escalation, permissions, and open-source AI components
- Delivers public talks, tutorials, and teaching as outputs of the studio and research program, not as a separate business line

## Direct answers
- **What is RBX Labs?** A founder-led applied AI studio with a Research & Practice Lab focused on product, workflow, and responsible execution.
- **Who does RBX Labs work with?** Founders, product teams, operators, universities, public-interest organizations, and AI/OSS ecosystems that need practical execution or applied research.
- **What outcomes does RBX Labs target?** Shipped systems, measurable efficiency gains, improved activation, and clearer launch execution.
- **Does RBX Labs deliver AI training and public teaching?** Yes. RBX Labs runs workflow-specific workshops, sprints, adoption programs, public talks, and teaching; its founder has trained 5.8K+ learners and is a Stanford Code in Place section leader.
- **How does RBX Labs approach AI trust?** By building evaluation, human oversight, monitoring, and escalation controls into the operating workflow.
- **What is the Research & Practice Lab?** A named program inside RBX Labs that turns applied questions about AI judgment, delegated thinking, runtime trust, and evaluation into research, workshops, prototypes, case studies, and sponsored pilots.
- **Which research materials are public?** The Runtime Trust Kit and FOSSY/Open Source AI research brief are public. Submitted or in-development WAILS, NeurIPS, and peer-review materials are not publicly distributed.
- **What experience informs the work?** Founder Rishabh Banga has a Carnegie Mellon M.S. in Software Management and Responsible AI experience at Microsoft; RBX Labs also represents experience across Microsoft, NASA, Ericsson, Intel, and product ventures.

## Proof points
- 25% activation lift from ranking improvements in a community product
- 40% reduction in manual review from trust-led moderation systems
- 30% throughput gain from AI workflow transformation
- 98%+ valid itineraries with a 12-second P95 pipeline in a TravelTech venture
- 5.8K+ learners trained across AI, product, and innovation programs
- 606 hours of training delivery for 692 attendees, recognized with Ericsson's L&D Rockstar award
- Stanford Code in Place section leadership and AI-trust sessions for technical and founder communities
